analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 62.7 holding neutral, MACD histogram improving for 4 consecutive days. The Higher Low pattern continues with the 5-day low at $502.22 and 20-day low at $486.00. Weekly ADX at 36.4 confirms a strong trend. 4-hour RSI at 60.6 indicates a bullish zone. Quantitative buy attractiveness is strong at 77/100. Position is at 1x target weight, next card is leverage.
